title: 20/20 BioLabs Reschedules Investor Webinar to 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on September 2, 2026 to Discuss OneTest Revenue and Expanding Commercial Opportunity
body: 20/20 Biolabs Q2 2026 revenue up about 37% to ~$0.7M as it eliminates all outstanding convertible note debt

questions.question: What number changed versus what was already priced?
questions.note: Q2 2026 revenue increased by ~37% to ~$0.7M, eliminating convertible note debt, which expands commercial opportunity and signals positive momentum for the named issuer (AIDX). This is a named issuer print with a clear directional number change.

questions.question: Is this one named issuer, or a factor that should not be pinned to a camera ticker?
questions.note: This is a named issuer (20/20 BioLabs/AIDX), not a factor. The revenue print is pinned to the company’s ticker.

questions.question: If guidance was only reaffirmed, why is an up call illegal?
questions.note: Guidance was not reaffirmed; the event is a revenue print with a clear directional change (up). No reaffirmation to invalidate.
